newsitem.title: UK: Premier says Albanian operation undisrupted.
newsitem.headline: Premier says Albanian operation undisrupted.

text.p: Premier Oil Plc said on Monday that its exploration project in the south of Albania, which employs a total of around 25 permanent staff, was not affected by the armed revolt in the Balkan state.
The Patoz Marinze oil field is located at about a three hours drive north of the southern town of Vlore, where the revolt started.
"None of this unrest is directed towards Premier or other foreign companies," chief executive Charles Jamieson said, adding measures to ensure staff safety had been taken.
About five of the employees are expatriates.
British oil minnow Premier has a 50 percent interest in the Patoz Marinze filed, which is being operated by Anglo Albanian Petroleum.
"We are viewing the situation very carefully and make sure the operation is secure," Jamieson said. "One has to be careful on the roads, but we are continuing."
